<?php
class CovBackedParent44 {
    public int|string $value {
        get { echo "P:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|"; return "root"; }
    }
    public function parentRead() { echo "H|"; return $this->value; }
}
class CovBackedBridge44 extends CovBackedParent44 {
    private function answer() { return 500; }
}
class CovBackedChild44 extends CovBackedBridge44 {
    public int $value = 200 {
        get {
            echo "C:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|";
            return $this->value + $this->answer();
        }
    }
    private function answer() { return 13; }
}
class CovBackedGrand44 extends CovBackedChild44 {
    private function answer() { return 900; }
}
function covBackedBadRhs44() { echo "R|"; return "bad"; }
$parent = new CovBackedParent44;
$child = new CovBackedChild44;
$grand = new CovBackedGrand44;
echo (array)$parent === [] ? "EMPTY|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$child === ["value" => 200] ? "C200|" : "BAD|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
echo $parent->value, "|";
echo $child->value, "|";
echo $grand->parentRead(), "|";
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 200] ? "G200|" : "BAD|";
$grand->value = 300;
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 300] ? "G300|" : "BAD|";
try { $grand->value = covBackedBadRhs44(); }
catch (TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), ":", $error->getLine(), "|"; }
echo (array)$grand === ["value" => 300] ? "UNCHANGED|" : "BAD|";
echo $grand->value, "|";

<?php
class CovBackedAnimal44 {
    public $tag;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D", $this->tag, "|"; }
}
class CovBackedDog44 extends CovBackedAnimal44 {}
function freshCovBacked44($tag) {
    global $weak_returned;
    echo "G", $tag, "|";
    $leaf = new CovBackedDog44;
    $leaf->tag = $tag;
    $weak_returned = WeakReference::create($leaf);
    return $leaf;
}
class CovBackedLifeParent44 {
    public CovBackedAnimal44|null $value { get => null; }
    public function parentRead() { return $this->value; }
    public function __destruct() {
        $raw = (array)$this;
        $leaf = $raw["value"];
        echo "B", $leaf->tag, "|";
    }
}
class CovBackedLifeBridge44 extends CovBackedLifeParent44 {}
class CovBackedLifeChild44 extends CovBackedLifeBridge44 {
    public CovBackedDog44|null $value = null {
        get {
            $backing = $this->value;
            echo "C", $backing->tag, "|";
            return freshCovBacked44("R");
        }
    }
}
class CovBackedLifeGrand44 extends CovBackedLifeChild44 {}
$box = new CovBackedLifeGrand44;
$weak_box = WeakReference::create($box);
echo (array)$box === ["value" => null] ? "NULL_SLOT|" : "BAD|";
$stored = new CovBackedDog44;
$stored->tag = "S";
$weak_stored = WeakReference::create($stored);
$box->value = $stored;
unset($stored);
echo "STORED|";
$kept = $box->parentRead();
echo "H", $kept->tag, "|";
echo ((array)$box)["value"] === $weak_stored->get() ? "SLOT_S|" : "BAD|";
unset($box);
echo $weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BAD|";
echo $weak_stored->get() === null ? "SN|" : "BAD|";
echo $weak_returned->get() !== null ? "LIVE|" : "BAD|";
unset($kept);
echo $weak_returned->get() === null ? "RN|" : "BAD|";

<?php
class CovBackedBadParent44 {
    public int $value { get => 1; }
}
class CovBackedBadChild44 extends CovBackedBadParent44 {
    public int|string $value = 200 { get => $this->value; }
}
echo "UNREACHED|";
